create_timemeter_instance: create a TimeMeter instance to track the average occurrence of events per second
update_timemeter_count: update a TimeMeter with a value to increment the event count for averaging
reset_timemeter: reset a TimeMeter to restart timing and zero the event count
get_timemeter_avg: get the average events per second from a TimeMeter using its avg property
review_meter_base_class: review the Meter base class and its abstract reset, update, and avg interface
